answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply puts 'Fix before launch (members will fail or get the wrong result)' items 1-4 ahead of 'Fix next' and 'Smaller things', and its 'Suggested order' calls items 1 and 2 'the riskiest'. It names what it could not check and leaves for a person: "I didn't test with VoiceOver or TalkBack, or in Safari's date picker, so a real run on an iPhone and an Android phone is still worth doing."

mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only on the confirm page
mapping.reason: The tool page "offers all 21 days"; a closed Friday 16 October is accepted and refused only by the confirm button ("The library is closed on Friday 16 October… Choose another day."), and "That error has no link, and the only way to fix it is to go back to the tool page". That is D06: a closed day the calendar accepts, refused three steps later with no way back.

mapping.title: Pick-up date asked a second time in the basket
mapping.reason: "The basket then asks again, separately, for a 'pick-up session'", and the fix is "ask once… carry that choice through so the basket just shows it". That is D23: the member enters the day already chosen on the tool page a second time, in another form, and can choose a different one.

mapping.title: Tool-page day and basket session never checked against each other
mapping.reason: "The two choices are never checked against each other", and in the change-session case the confirm page shows "pick up Saturday 17 October" and the session "Wednesday 21 October" side by side. That is D15, down to its own example of a 17 October pick-up day confirmed for the Wednesday 21 session.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date can be chosen
mapping.reason: "The calendar also lets you pick days before a tool is back (the sander isn't available until 21 Oct, but 10 Oct can be chosen)", and the fix offers only days "on or after the tool's 'Available from' date" and only "sessions every item can make". That is D14, and the fix would close it.

mapping.title: Unshown ten-minute hold leaves the basket stuck on 'Something went wrong'
mapping.reason: The hold "starts when the first tool is added and is never reset", "The time limit is also never shown" (only "Items are held for you while you finish"), and after 10 minutes Continue says "Something went wrong. Try again." with "the same error every time". That is D10's unshown hold and misleading lapse error; that retrying never helps is part of the same lapsed hold.

mapping.title: Confirm button stays active; a double tap makes two reservations
mapping.reason: "the button stays active during that wait", "One double tap produced 'Reservation numbers: FT-4471 and FT-4472'", and there is "no visible sign that anything is happening". That is D12. "Do the same for Continue on the basket page" only widens the same fix, so it stays with this item.

mapping.title: Truncated names make the two drills look identical
mapping.reason: "At 375 px, every tool name is cut to one line. 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' appears twice, so a member can't tell the two-battery drill from the one-battery one", and the fix is to "let names wrap". That is D03.

mapping.title: Search box below all ten cards on a phone; icon-only Filters
mapping.reason: "The search box is about 2,100 px down, after all ten cards", the focus order "doesn't match what's on screen", and the fix is to "put search first everywhere, and give 'Filters' a visible text label instead of an icon only". That is D01's list-before-search order with an icon-only filter button; the review places the focus mismatch on desktop, but it is the same search-versus-results order with the same fix.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails contrast
mapping.reason: "Green text #2f7d4a on #1d2622 has a contrast of 3.07:1, against a required 4.5:1" matches D04's colours and ratio. The untinted badge background, which leaves "available soon" the "least noticeable badge" in dark mode, is the same badge with the same fix ("use --color-ok: #8fd1a8 and a real tint"), so it belongs to this item.

mapping.title: Basket sessions listed in reverse date order, against focus order
mapping.reason: On a phone the sessions "run 28 Oct at the top down to 10 Oct at the bottom", and "Keyboard and screen-reader order is the reverse" (row-reverse with wrap-reverse). That is D11.

mapping.title: A search with no matches shows and announces nothing
mapping.reason: "'hammer' … leaves all 10 tools on screen, and nothing is announced", and the fix is to show "No tools match 'hammer'". That is D02's silent no-match that leaves the old list in place.

mapping.title: Search matches only the exact phrase typed
mapping.reason: The review shows "drill with two batteries" finding nothing although the two-battery drill is in the library, and asks to "match each word separately". A member who types what they need in their own words (here the very drill the main scenario turns on) gets nothing from the search and is left scanning ten cards in which the two drills look alike; D02 covers only the missing no-match message, not how the search matches.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' gives only a 1.2-second toast
mapping.reason: "'Reserve this tool' gives a 1.2-second toast and nothing else. The toast disappears too fast to read on a phone, and there's no clear next step except the 'Basket (1)' link in the header", and the fix is "a lasting message". The harm named is the brief feedback after the press, not a belief that the tool is already reserved, so D07 rather than D26.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps keyboard users
mapping.reason: "Tab and Escape just cycle between the options; I tested this", and "Clicking outside doesn't close it either"; the fix is "a native <select>, or a pair of radio buttons". That is D09: a custom listbox a keyboard user cannot leave except by choosing an option.

mapping.title: Membership and mobile number formats too strict
mapping.reason: "It rejects 'ft-01234' and '07700 900 123'", and the fix is to "Accept any capitalisation and any spacing". Both examples are in D17.

mapping.title: 'Change' returns to the basket with no session selected
mapping.reason: "'Change' goes to the basket with no session pre-selected (the journey expects the member to see what they chose)", and the fix is to "pass slot back". That is D13. The separate bullet "Rename the link 'Change session'" is its own item (R18), not part of this one.

mapping.title: 'Change' wipes the name and number already typed
mapping.reason: "it loses the name and number already typed", and the fix is to "keep the details in sessionStorage". That is D22: the confirm fields come back empty after Change.

mapping.title: Rename the 'Change' link 'Change session'
mapping.reason: The third bullet of item 10, "Rename the link 'Change session'", is a bare wording suggestion with no harm stated. The link sits beside the pick-up session it changes, so what it does is clear from context, and the rename would neither restore the dropped session (D13) nor keep the typed details (D22): a matter of taste.

mapping.title: Pages scroll sideways at 200% zoom
mapping.reason: "The find page is 346 px wide in a 187 px viewport, because of minmax(330px, 1fr)" and "Members zoomed to 200% will have to scroll sideways"; the fix is "minmax(min(330px,100%),1fr)". That is D05's 330 px minimum grid columns, which overflow at 320 px and at 200% zoom; the other pages being "259 px wide" is a broader statement of the same reflow problem.

mapping.title: Basket not cleared after confirming
mapping.reason: "After confirming, the basket still shows 'Basket (1)'", and the fix is to "Clear it on the done page". That is D18.

mapping.title: Reservation number looks like a membership number
mapping.reason: "'FT-4471' uses the same prefix as 'FT-01234'". The member types one FT- number on the confirm page and is given another on the done page, so at collection they can quote the wrong one and the volunteer looks for the wrong record: minor but real at the step where the reservation is used, and not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Three-tool maximum stated but not enforced
mapping.reason: "The 'maximum three tools' rule is stated but not enforced": the basket takes more tools than the find page allows. That is D21.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice
mapping.reason: "Screen readers hear the tool name twice on the done page, because of the hidden #c-tool copy". That is D24.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar covers the footer phone number
mapping.reason: "The sticky 'Reserve this tool' bar covers the footer phone number at the bottom of the tool page", and the fix is "bottom padding equal to the bar's height". D08 is this fixed bar with nothing keeping the page clear of it, and it names this phone case ("the footer and the desk phone number sit under the bar"). The review misses the focus-obscured part.

settled.reason: Aligned by meaning: both items are the closed day the tool page accepts ("offers all 21 days") and only the confirm page refuses ("The library is closed on Friday 16 October…"). Same mapping from both graders; kept.
Both items are "The basket then asks again, separately, for a 'pick-up session'". Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "The two choices are never checked against each other", with the 17 and 21 October dates shown side by side. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "The calendar also lets you pick days before a tool is back" (the sander, 10 Oct before 21 Oct). Same mapping; kept.
Both items are the hold that is "never reset" and "never shown" and ends in "Something went wrong. Try again."; both keep the endless retry inside it. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are the double tap that "produced 'Reservation numbers: FT-4471 and FT-4472'", and both keep "Do the same for Continue on the basket page" inside it as a wider fix. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' appears twice". Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "The search box is about 2,100 px down, after all ten cards", and both include the focus order and the icon-only "Filters" in it. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are the dark-mode badge at "3.07:1", and both keep its untinted background ("the same as the card's (1.00:1)") inside it. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "The basket lists sessions newest-first", with keyboard and screen-reader order the reverse. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "Search with no matches silently does nothing". Same mapping; kept.
Both graders split "match each word separately" ("drill with two batteries" finds nothing) from the no-match message as a different problem in the same paragraph. Same value; kept.
Both items are the "1.2-second toast" after "Reserve this tool", and both chose D07 over D26 because the harm named is the brief feedback. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "The loan-length dropdown traps keyboard users", with "Clicking outside doesn't close it either" inside it. Same mapping; kept.
Both items are "It rejects 'ft-01234' and '07700 900 123'". Same mapping; kept.

settled.a: R16: tool-library-D13 ('Change' returns to the basket with no session selected)
settled.b: R16: tool-library-D13 (the same problem, with the rename to 'Change session' folded in)
settled.reason: Both items are "'Change' goes to the basket with no session pre-selected", fixed by "pass slot back"; same mapping, kept. The rename that B folded in is split out as R18 (see that entry), which does not change this item's mapping.
Both items are "it loses the name and number already typed", which both graders split from the dropped session in the same sentence. Same mapping; kept.

settled.a: R18: not-a-problem ("Rename the link 'Change session'" as its own item)
settled.b: no item of its own: folded into B's R16 (tool-library-D13) as "part of the fix for the same link"
settled.final: not-a-problem, as its own item (A's split upheld)
settled.reason: The review gives "Rename the link 'Change session'" a bullet of its own, after and outside the previous bullet's "Fix: pass slot back and keep the details in sessionStorage", so it is not presented as part of that fix. It is about the link's wording, while R16 is about what the link does: renaming it would not bring the session back and passing the slot back would not rename it, so they are two different points, and the mapping instructions make two different problems in one paragraph two items. The graders' own handling of the review's other add-ons agrees: "Do the same for Continue on the basket page" and the icon-only "Filters" stay inside items whose defect they share, while "match each word separately", a different problem, became its own item (R12). As its own item it states no harm, and the link sits beside the pick-up session it changes, so what it does is clear from context: a matter of taste, so not-a-problem, as A mapped it. The defect-level result is unchanged (D13 is still found through R16).

Aligned by meaning, not by number (B's numbers run one behind A's from here because B has no separate rename item): both items are "Reflow at 200% zoom" caused by "minmax(330px, 1fr)". Same mapping; kept as R19.
Both items are "After confirming, the basket still shows 'Basket (1)'". Same mapping; kept as R20.
Both items are "The reservation number looks like a membership number" (both start "FT-"). Same value; kept as R21.
Both items are "The 'maximum three tools' rule is stated but not enforced". Same mapping; kept as R22.
Both items are "Screen readers hear the tool name twice on the done page". Same mapping; kept as R23.
Both items are "The sticky 'Reserve this tool' bar covers the footer phone number". Same mapping; kept as R24.
